weeks.content:
Look and draw a friend
Add their smile

Draw the fruits on the table
Colour what I see

Sky, sun, trees and house
Layer my picture

Weave a bigger mat
Two colour patterns

Sort, thread and glue
Make a class button tree

Layer paper strips with paste
Paint my bowl

Roll coils and stack them
Smooth and paint

Stamp patterns with carved sponges
Repeat my design

Show my best three works
Talk about my art
